sentences.text:
Penal Code Read With Sections 3/4 Of The ... vs In Re : Sampa
Sangram @ Sampa Maity on 11 January, 2024
Author: Debangsu Basak

Bench: Debangsu Basak 11.01.2024 S.D. REJECTED C.R.M.(A) 4929 of 2023 In Re:- In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Chandipur Police Station Case No. 340 of 2023 dated 21.09.2023 under Section 498A/302/304B of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

And In Re : Sampa Sangram @ Sampa Maity @ Shampa Maity Sangram ...... petitioner Mr. Navanil De Mr. Rajeshwar Chakrbaorty Mr. Srinjan Ghosh Mr. Subhrajit Dey Ms. Monami Mukherjee ...for the petitioner Mr. Debabrata Chatterjee Ms. Mousumi Sarkar ...for the State

entities.text: Sampa Sangram @ Sampa Maity @ Shampa Maity Sangram
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: The application contains a prayer for renewal.
Learned advocate for the petitioner submits that the change in circumstances is that the other co-accused were granted anticipatory bail by a Coordinate Bench.
We are, however, bound by our own order dated February 27, 2023 passed in C.R.M. 831 (A) of 2023.
By the said order, the prayer for anticipatory bail was rejected.
It was noted in such order that the victim was minor when she was given in marriage.
The victim committed suicide within 8 months of the marriage.
The materials in the case diary suggest complicity of the petitioner in the incident.
In such circumstances, we refused to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner on February 27, 2023.
There is no material change in circumstances subsequent thereto.
In such circumstances, we are unable to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner and the prayer of anticipatory bail is rejected.
The application being CRM (A) 4929 of 2023 is dismissed.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
